name: Zoya
msgs: I need to tell you something and I'm scared.
I think I'm falling for the version of you that only exists at 3 AM.
The one who tells the truth.
Then meet me at 3 PM. I'll be brave in daylight too.
I've never been late for you.
closer: Some people are only honest in the dark. Love asks for daylight too.
follow: Next: Ep. 4 · a new couple tomorrow
